integrity: Analytic proof is based on the cited monomial coefficient matrix and compactness theorem, Cauchy minors, exterior products, compact strong-to-norm convergence, and a finite Gram determinant. Exact rational finite checks are supplemental; they are not a proof of the infinite-dimensional claims.
scientific_limitations: Fixed source weight \(-1<\alpha<0\), compact two-weight regime \(\beta>\alpha+2\), and fixed singular index before \(\beta\) tends to infinity. No uniform rank growth, general Bergman exponent, or independently certified publication-priority result.
title: High-target-weight singular-value hierarchy for the differential Hilbert operator
